purpose: Audit whether SEC filing acceptance timestamps can be reconstructed consistently from independently exposed official representations before any information-processing-friction performance use.

sample_rule.selection: For each fixed symbol, choose the two earliest eligible 8-K accessions by SEC acceptanceDateTime, breaking ties by accession number. Selection is source-feasibility-only and is not conditioned on returns, events or later outcomes.

clock_fields.comparison: Compare exact timestamp digits/wall-clock representation first; never silently infer an absolute timezone when the source representation does not declare one.

pass_conditions: Every selected accession has all three official representations retrievable.
Complete-submission and index-header acceptance timestamp digits are identical.
Submission API acceptanceDateTime has the same timestamp digits after parsing its explicit ISO representation.
Accession identity and filer CIK remain consistent across all fetched representations.
fail_closed_conditions: Any attempt to infer or substitute a missing historical timestamp from a later source.
mutation_tests: A synthetic future filing cannot alter any earlier audit result.
Timestamp mismatch is surfaced as a failure rather than normalized away.
